articles.title: Switch 2 被发现桌面同款 DLSS 4：输入特征缩减 75%、预设 H/I 两大低负载模式
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 17 日消息，开发者 Eren Doğan 昨日（11 月 16 日）在 X 平台发布推文，披露称他从任天堂 Switch 2 中提取出英伟达 DLSS 模型，发现其中包含 DLSS 4 引入的第一代 Transformer 模型，模型权重与 PC 桌面版相同，但未发现 DLSS 4.5 模型。根据挖掘的代码信息，Switch 2 配有名为 H 和 I 的两套专属预设。按照 Doğan 的分析，它们采用卷积神经网络，也就是 CNN 模型，模型大小与常规桌面版相同，但输入的特征网格规模仅为后者的四分之一，因此能够减少计算负担、加快处理，实际提速幅度仍待测试验证。他认为，这可能就是此前被称为“DLSS Lite”或“Tiny DLSS”的轻量方案。IT之家查询公开资料，输入特征网格规模就是 AI 处理画面时，需要分析多大一张信息网格。网格越大，通常需要处理的信息越多；网格缩小，则有机会降低计算负担。

articles.title: 刷新水深纪录，我国“梦想”号大洋钻探船完成重大装备海试任务
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 17 日消息，据央视新闻今日报道，我国“梦想”号大洋钻探船近日圆满完成开路泥浆循环系统的海试任务，刷新了同类系统国际最大作业水深纪录。“梦想”号是全球唯一具备 11000 米钻探能力的大洋钻探船，具备大洋钻探、深海油气勘探等多种作业能力。本次海试任务历时 33 天，搭载的回收循环钻井系统分别在 142.7 米和 2004.8 米水深海域完成全流程作业及功能验证，成功实现泥浆循环回收与再利用。中国地质调查局天然气水合物工程技术中心开发室主任于彦江介绍，这套系统能够在钻井系统开路钻进的情况下，实现泥浆的循环、回收与再利用，可以有效解决长周期深海钻探所面临的泥浆消耗量巨大，以及井口安全影响这两个关键问题，具有安全、高效、绿色的功能。IT之家注意到，“梦想”号入列两年来，成功应用 4 种钻探模式，先后完成井控系统海试、天然气水合物钻探、大洋科学钻探试钻等 9 个航次任务。自然资源部中国地质调查局介绍，在我国首艘大洋钻探船入列两周年之际，历时 33 天，“梦想”号圆满完成我国自主研发的首套 2000 米级深海无隔水管泥浆回收循环钻井系统海试任务，填补了国内相关领域技术空白，刷新同类系统国际最大作业水深纪录。“梦想”号搭载了全球首套兼具油气勘探和岩心钻取功能的液压举升钻机，具备大洋钻探、深海油气勘探和天然气水合物勘查试采等多种作业能力。

articles.title: R 星跨界联动天气频道公布《GTA6》全新截图，展示雷奥奈达州的动态天气效果
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 17 日消息，天气频道（The Weather Channel）今日在 X 平台发文，与 Rockstar 共同公布一批《GTA6》游戏新截图，旨在展示雷奥奈达州的动态天气效果。Rockstar Games 美术副总裁（光照与渲染）欧文 · 谢泼德表示，《GTA6》拥有 GTA 系列游戏最深入、最具沉浸感的体验，因此 R 星重新构想了游戏的天气系统，使其更具地域特色，更加动态。雷奥奈达州的天气变化多样，有时候是晴朗无云的蓝天，也会出现高耸得令人眩晕的积雨云。R 星希望通过天气让玩家更真切地融入游戏世界，也希望佛罗里达州的本地居民，以及初次来到雷奥奈达州的新玩家感到共鸣。IT之家附本次公布的全新截图如下：强降雨激起大量水汽，导致佛罗里达礁岛群多地能见度不佳。幸好有关部门已经在部分道路安装反光道钉，为雨天出行的市民提供帮助。（你最好还是去 Coastal Auto Care 汽修店把车灯修好。）今天最好不要在鹈鹕谷（Pelican Valley）的沼泽中涉水而行。这里的水质平时就很浑浊，这场暴风雨更让人几乎无法发现那些爱咬人的大家伙！如果你今早预订了南海洋沙滩的酒店，那么你花高价换来的美景，可能会被一道从海上涌来的海雾墙遮住。如果你今天打算去锈锚酒吧（Rusty Anchor）喝两杯，可能需要准备一艘更大的船。热带风暴已经让海面变得波涛汹涌。高湿度让甘比特湾（Gambit Bay）的水面笼罩一层低空薄雾，让狩猎季在一片宁静中拉开帷幕！今早又是风又是雨，从基伦托（Key Lento）出发的通勤之路可谓相当“刺激”！

articles.title: 含 1/48 概率稀有夜光版：Camp Snap 最小复古数码摄像机 CS-8 Micro 即将盲盒开售
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 17 日消息，科技媒体 digitaltrends 昨日（11 月 16 日）发布博文，报道称 Camp Snap 宣布将于美国当地时间 11 月 17 日上午 11 点（北京时间 18 日凌晨 0 点）推出迷你复古数码摄像机 CS-8 Micro，售价为 39.99 美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 267.1 元人民币），这也是其最小的复古数码摄像机。这款新品将传统手持摄像机缩小至钥匙扣尺寸，机身长约 7.6 厘米、重约 42.5 克，可挂在钥匙链或背包上。外观延续复古风格，但内部采用数字成像，并不使用胶片。拍摄方面，CS-8 Micro 支持 720p 视频和 8 倍数码变焦，内置五种滤镜，可通过颗粒、闪烁等效果模拟老式胶片影像。机身配备一块小型 LCD 屏幕，不过仅供取景，无法直接回放、编辑或删除视频，用户需要导出文件后查看。产品随附一张 4GB microSD 存储卡，约可保存 45 至 60 分钟视频；内置电池充满后，预计可连续拍摄约 30 至 45 分钟。拍摄内容可通过 USB-C 接口或取出存储卡导出。销售方式也是新品的一大看点：它采用密封盲盒包装，提供亮粉、丁香紫、青柠绿和橙色等配色，另设更稀有的黑色复古经典款及夜光款，概率分别为 1/24 和 1/48。相关阅读：《Camp Snap 推出复古摄像机 CS-8 Micro：盲盒形式销售，可挂在钥匙链上随身携带，39.99 美元》

articles.title: 不法分子借微软 365 宕机实施大规模钓鱼攻击，伪造邮件通知窃取用户账号
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 17 日消息，微软威胁情报团队发现，一场针对多个组织的大规模钓鱼攻击活动正在利用近期 Microsoft 365 服务中断事件实施攻击。攻击者通过向用户发送伪装成微软 365 服务健康通知的邮件，诱导收件人点击链接，从而窃取账户登录凭证。微软威胁情报团队于当地时间 11 月 13 日监测到这场钓鱼活动。钓鱼邮件冒充 Microsoft 365 服务健康通知，并引用真实发生的 Exchange Online 服务故障事件编号 EX1550543，以增强邮件的可信度。据介绍，这些邮件通常使用以“Outage -”开头、后接六位字符代码的主题，发件人显示名称则包含针对不同组织定制的名称，并附带“Outage Notification”或“Service Health”等字样。微软发现，攻击活动使用了 moments-notice.com、planetmaison.com 和 newbooker.com 三个发件域名。邮件中的链接通过针对收件人定制的 SendGrid 点击跟踪地址进行跳转，最终指向 reallifeaccounting.com。微软表示，类似邮件已经针对美国多个行业的组织展开攻击。微软判断，这场活动符合凭证钓鱼攻击的特征，其主要目的很可能是诱骗用户提交 Microsoft 365 账户登录信息。不过，微软强调，现有证据尚未证实攻击者已经成功窃取凭证，也没有确认发生恶意软件投递或后续入侵活动。微软还表示，Microsoft Defender 相关安全产品已经开始拦截此次攻击活动中的恶意域名和钓鱼邮件，并将继续监测相关威胁。此次钓鱼活动利用的是 11 月 12 日发生的 Microsoft 365 服务中断事件。当时，Exchange Online 邮箱访问受到影响，Outlook 等服务出现异常，部分地区用户无法正常收发邮件。微软将该故障编号记录为 EX1550543，并于 11 月 13 日宣布相关事件已经解决。微软建议企业安全团队通过 Microsoft Defender for Office 365 的威胁资源管理器检查可疑邮件，并利用 Microsoft Defender XDR 高级狩猎功能排查邮件及链接访问记录。同时，用户应通过 Microsoft 365 管理中心核实服务状态，不要直接点击来源不明的邮件链接恢复所谓被拦截的邮件。

articles.title: 苹果为 Apple TV 引入“短视频”竖屏格式和视频播客功能：无需订阅即可观看播客，覆盖 iPhone、iPad、Mac 等设备
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 17 日消息，据 9to5mac 今日报道，苹果在最新的 iOS 27.3 Beta 2 中为 Apple TV 应用新增了两种新特性：“短视频”竖屏格式和视频播客功能。正如字面意思，竖屏格式的加入可以让用户通过类似 TikTok 等短视频平台的界面来体验 Apple TV 内容预览，而 Netflix 和 Disney+ 等流媒体平台此前已经加入类似功能。苹果计划在 iOS 27.3、iPadOS 27.3 及其他系统更新中，将视频播客内容引入 Apple TV 应用，用户届时无需订阅 Apple TV+ 也可以通过苹果多个设备及第三方电视平台发现和观看视频播客。苹果将在 Apple TV 应用中整合来自 Apple Podcasts 应用的视频播客节目，用户可以在 iPhone、iPad、Mac、Apple TV 4K，以及支持 Apple TV 应用的智能电视和机顶盒上观看相关内容。此外，支持 CarPlay 的汽车也将提供观看入口，进一步扩展相关内容的使用场景。在收费方面，苹果明确表示，Apple TV 应用中的视频播客可以免费观看，不需要订阅 Apple TV+。不过，需要付费订阅才能收听或观看的播客节目不会被纳入 Apple TV 应用。开发者已经可以通过苹果当天发布的 iOS 27.3 第二个开发者测试版，访问 Apple TV 应用中的播客视频内容。

articles.content: IT之家 11 月 17 日消息，科技媒体 Business Insider 今天（11 月 17 日）发布博文，报道称人工智能公司 Anthropic 为了降低内幕交易风险，计划在首次公开募股（IPO）后，要求出售公司股票的员工使用预设交易计划。对于 Anthropic 公司员工而言，未来他们如果想要出售持股，大多需要提前做好安排，而不能看到股价上涨或突发消息后立即决定卖出。这套机制名为“10b5-1 交易计划”，通常情况下用于企业高管。员工须通过书面协议，预先确定股票出售数量、价格条件和出售日期（至少 30 天后）。报道指出相比美国不少科技公司主要通过特定时段禁止员工交易，Anthropic 的这种安排约束更强。为 Anthropic 员工提供服务的 Aspiriant 财富管理总监 Teresa Greenip 表示，这项政策将在两个初始售股窗口结束后实施：公司上市当天，员工可出售所持股份的 10%；明年初公司首次季度财报发布后，还可再出售 35%。此后，员工须在季度财报前后的五天交易窗口内制定售股计划，许多员工从制定计划到执行交易，需等待 60 天。Greenip 认为，预先规划交易既能减少员工因市场消息而冲动买卖，也有利于公司在内部分享财务等敏感信息，降低相关内幕交易风险，但并不意味着员工交易可以自动免除合规责任。据报道，Anthropic 截至 9 月底约有 5,300 名员工，IPO 目标估值为 1.4 万亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 9.35 万亿元人民币）。Greenip 称，公司鼓励员工不要过度关注每日股价波动。

articles.content: IT之家 11 月 17 日消息，苹果今日向 iPad 和 Mac 用户推送 iPadOS 27.3 DP Beta 2（24C5049d）和 macOS 27.3 DP Beta 2（26C5047e）操作系统，为国行 iPad 和 Mac 设备新增“Apple 智能”（Apple Intelligence）功能。综合 Macrumors 报道及IT之家小伙伴实测，搭载 M 系列苹果芯片的 Mac 和 iPad 均可使用 Apple 智能，使用 A17 Pro 和 A20 Pro 芯片的 iPad mini 也在支持范围内。国行机型的 Apple 智能不包含 Siri AI，也不支持 iOS 27 中新增的部分 Apple 智能功能，但包含许多最早随 iOS 18.1 在美国推出的功能。其中 Siri 和写作工具等接入了千问大模型，集成方式类似其他国家或地区设备接入的 ChatGPT。据IT之家此前援引“网信上海”公众号，根据《生成式人工智能服务管理暂行办法》相关要求，“Apple 智能”生成式人工智能服务新增苹果平板和苹果笔记本电脑两类场景，已完成备案。目前适用场景为苹果手机、平板、笔记本电脑。

articles.title: 几十元即可破解儿童电话手表，刷机多重安全风险不容忽视
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 17 日消息，在电商平台和视频网站上，远程刷机、破解电话手表家长监管功能的教程和服务并不难找，报价大多在 30 元至 60 元。商家支持远程操作，也可邮寄手表线下刷机，还能安装第三方 App，且不核实顾客身份。中央广播电视总台中国之声今日报道称，电话手表如今已成为不少孩子的“标配”，甚至有些小朋友把电话手表当成了自己的“社交硬通货”。除了通话、定位、拍照、支付外，家长监管功能才是家长最为看重的防线。一旦这道防线被绕开，带来的就不只是“多装几个软件”的问题。央视记者在某视频网站搜索“电话手表刷机教程”发现相关视频不少，部分播放量相当可观；在某电商平台搜索“电话手表、刷机、破解”等关键词，同样能找到多家提供破解服务的商家。对此，不少家长表示担忧。家长吴先生认为，小孩子没有判断对错的能力，如果绕开父母监管，可能被不良商家往不好的方面引导，刷机对资金和其他方面也不安全。广西大学计算机与电子信息学院院长助理兰伟介绍，电话手表虽然体积小，但本质上是一台智能联网设备。刷机是对设备原有系统的修改，不仅会改变设备功能，也会影响原有系统的管理机制和安全保护能力，除信息安全隐患外，还会对资金安全造成威胁。广西华胜律师事务所马郡骏律师告诉记者，刷机对普通用户不违法，但会失去保修、失去系统安全防护，孩子的定位、通话、照片可能暴露。收费帮人刷机、发布破解教程的性质则不同，这类工具的功能突破厂商的安全保护措施，达到一定人次或违法所得，需要承担相应的行政责任或刑事责任。马郡骏表示，刷机行为本身的违法性来自“突破安全保护措施”和“未经同意处理个人信息”两个环节，谁实施谁承担责任。如果发现电话手表被刷机，使用者要及时保存证据，依法维护自身权利。马郡骏提醒，发现手表被刷机后先不要着急恢复出厂设置，应先固定证据，如聊天记录、付款记录、扣费记录、骚扰电话等截图，以及手表里应用的权限状态，进行截屏、录屏，必要时做公证，并分别向网信部门、公安部门、市场监督管理局以及消费者协会投诉；若通过平台购买设备，需再找平台，最后可以向法院起诉。若泄露个人信息，按个人信息保护纠纷起诉；涉扣费的，按服务合同起诉；若服务有欺诈，可要求三倍赔偿。兰伟提醒，从设备信息安全角度，使用者应及时做技术修复，消除隐患。建议优先恢复官方系统，使用正规渠道重新配置设备，不建议继续使用来路不明的系统和软件，同时检查账号安全情况，修改账号密码，查看有无异常登录或异常授权，并检查设备有无陌生应用程序，尤其是来路不明、权限较高的软件。家长在使用过程中需重视数据和隐私保护。

articles.title: 英特尔 350W 新卡 D270 亮剑，金融算力较英伟达 600W 加速卡飙升 5.9 倍
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 16 日消息，英特尔 11 月 16 日公布数据中心 GPU D270 的性能数据，称这款功耗设定为 350W 的加速卡，在特定金融计算测试中的应用吞吐量，最高达到 600W 英伟达 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 服务器版的 5.9 倍。规格方面，数据中心 GPU D270 相关信息如下：硅片与精度：Xe 3P 架构，32 个 Xe 核心，256 个 XMX 引擎；原生支持 FP4 到 FP64，具备全速率双精度计算能力。内存与平台：160 GB LPDDR5X（带宽 1.5 TB/s，可扩展至 480 GB）；350W PCIe 5.0 风冷规格。工作负载与生态：支持 HPC 场景（例如金融建模、地震成像）、解耦部署以及智能体 AI 推理；通过开放软件栈完成编程开发。英特尔在博文中指出，高性能计算（HPC）正在经历根本性转变，传统大规模数值建模与模拟依然是基础，但科研与企业环境正越来越多地在连续工作流中集成模拟、分析与 AI 推理。新兴的智能体 AI 架构加速了这一演进，将数据、模型与领域工具连接成自主循环，完成输入准备、中间输出评估，并动态引导下一步模拟操作。这种融合趋势需要异构基础设施，由不同计算引擎执行工作流的各个阶段。此前代号为 Crescent Island 的英特尔 GPU D270 正是针对该环境设计。虽然它从底层为高效 AI 推理打造，但其架构提供了苛刻 HPC 环境所需的高精度计算能力、大容量内存以及标准企业级外形。科研、工程与金融模拟依赖双精度运算来保持数值保真度，避免舍入误差累积。基于英特尔 Xe 3P 架构打造的英特尔 GPU D270 配备 32 个 Xe 核心与 256 个 Xe Matrix Extensions（XMX）引擎，每个核心可提供 64 次 FP64 融合乘加（FMA）运算。该架构为开发者提供了精度可选性：在需要推理吞吐量的场景使用低精度（FP4 到 FP8），在数学精度不可妥协的场景使用全速率原生 FP64 计算。内存架构对于处理复杂工作集同样关键。这款英特尔品牌板卡搭载 160 GB 高速 LPDDR5X 内存，带宽达 1.5 TB/s，合作伙伴设计的配置可扩展至 480 GB。这一大容量内存让研究人员可以将海量数据集与波场常驻在 GPU 上，尽可能减少跨主机总线的高成本数据搬运。所有计算密度集成在标准 350W 风冷 PCIe 外形中，可部署在标准企业服务器内，也可跨机架扩展部署。基于预生产硅片的真实应用基准测试，展现了 D270 平衡架构在金融分析与科学模拟场景中的切实优势：金融服务领域：在期权定价基准测试中，D270 相比 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 服务器版应用吞吐量最高提升至 5.9 倍 [1]，在算力密集型金融建模中展现出更优性能。考虑到 D270 功耗为 350W，而 NVIDIA GPU 功耗为 600W，这一性能表现尤为突出。工作负载应用 / 模型基准硬件英特尔 GPU D270 测试结果金融服务欧式蒙特卡洛模拟RTX PRO 6000（Blackwell）吞吐量达 5.9 倍金融服务布莱克-斯科尔斯模型（欧式）RTX PRO 6000（Blackwell）吞吐量达 5.6 计算能力，在该工作负载中展现出强大性能。缓存感知模板优化最大化了本地缓存的数据复用，让大型波场阵列直接常驻在板卡上。英特尔将在超算 2026（Supercomputing ‘26）的展位上通过现场演示展示地震建模能力。对于科学计算而言，核心逻辑十分清晰：大容量内存可以处理更大规模的问题，更智能的数据复用简化了数据搬运流程，经过优化的开放编程模型可以提供研究人员所需的应用吞吐量。在现代科学发现中，AI 推理不再是模拟结束后才运行的独立任务，而是直接在模拟循环内部运行。预训练 AI articles.title: 苹果反对加拿大 C-22 法案，称相关规定可能引入加密后门、削弱用户数据安全
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 17 日消息，据 MacRumors 今日报道，苹果公司正敦促加拿大政府修改一项涉及执法机构获取用户数字信息的法案，称相关规定可能削弱苹果产品现有的隐私和安全保护机制。这项法案旨在帮助加拿大警方和情报机构在调查过程中获取数字信息。目前，苹果、谷歌和 Meta 均在游说加拿大议员，希望调整正在审议的 C-22 法案。根据彭博社报道，这项法案可能要求科技公司修改自身服务，为政府访问用户数据提供专门工具，相关要求需要获得加拿大情报专员批准。法案还可能要求部分服务提供商保存用户连接记录，最长达 6 个月。这类记录属于元数据，不包括消息内容、浏览历史以及社交媒体活动记录。加拿大立法者此前已经对法案增加了一些限制措施。例如，只有在企业本身提供加密服务，且已经掌握解锁加密数据所需信息的情况下，政府才能要求其解锁相关数据。法案还规定，企业不能被强制要求在服务中引入某些安全漏洞。不过，苹果认为，这些修改仍不足以消除相关风险。苹果表示，尽管欢迎加拿大政府对法案作出的调整，但现有条款仍可能损害公司保护用户数据的能力。苹果此前还警告称，该法案可能允许执法机构要求企业建立加密后门。据悉，Meta、Signal 和 Tailscale 的代表也计划于 11 月 16 日出席加拿大参议院相关委员会听证会，表达对法案的意见。IT之家注：目前 C-22 法案尚未正式成为法律，仍处于加拿大参议院审议阶段。

articles.title: “流星雨之王”狮子座流星雨今晚至明日迎来极大期，专家建议后半夜肉眼观测
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 17 日消息，据新华社及央视报道，有着“流星雨之王”美誉的狮子座流星雨将于 11 月 18 日凌晨迎来极大期，最佳观测窗口为 18 日凌晨至天亮前。狮子座流星雨以速度快、亮度高为特色，偶尔会出现耀眼的火流星。狮子座流星雨的母体是坦普尔-塔特尔彗星。星联 CSVA 联合发起人、天文科普专家蒋晨明介绍，坦普尔-塔特尔彗星在绕日运行中，尘埃弥散在整个轨道上。每年 11 月地球穿过这条尘埃轨道，尘埃颗粒闯入大气层形成流星雨，因流星看起来以狮子座为辐射点向外散开而得名。狮子座流星雨以速度快、亮度高为特色，偶尔出现耀眼的火流星。它不在北半球三大流星雨之列，却因此前几场大爆发而家喻户晓，收获了“流星雨之王”的称号。其爆发具有一定周期性，大约每 33 年有机会迎来大规模爆发。在非爆发年份，狮子座流星雨流量表现较为平稳，ZHR（IT之家注：天顶每时出现率，指辐射点位于天顶时每小时可见流星数）一般在 10 至 20 之间。蒋晨明表示，今年 ZHR 约为 15，只要耐心守候，仍有机会邂逅转瞬即逝的流星。狮子座流星雨活跃期为每年 11 月 6 日至 30 日，极大期通常出现在 17 日左右。蒋晨明介绍，辐射点要等到午夜之后才会升到适宜高度，最佳观测时段主要在后半夜，尤其是天亮前。月光是观测流星雨的主要干扰因素，好在 18 日零点过后，我国多地月亮已经或即将落下，月光影响消失或大幅减弱。蒋晨明提醒，观测流星雨优先用肉眼观看，尽量远离城市光污染，选择暗夜环境。观测时不必一直盯着狮子座方向，流星可能出现在夜空任意方位。眼下正值初冬时节，天气寒冷，观测时需注意防寒保暖。

articles.content: I've noticed the same pattern across three different Claude-coded projects now. Initial velocity is strong, but starts to fade until returns are negative.It seems a combination of changes in model behavior and increasing code base size—emphasis on the latter. The larger the code base and documented history/progress (e.g. through updates to completed work and instructions, as in .md files), the more drift starts to set in.At a certain point, you get collapse. This is where it can't maintain consistency within a single unit of work. articles.title: 苹果 iOS 27.3 测试版新增 Siri AI 每日限额，付费订阅 iCloud+ 可提升 2~20 倍
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 17 日消息，据 MacRumors 今日报道，苹果正在测试为 Siri AI 和 Apple Intelligence 引入每日免费使用额度，并允许用户通过订阅 iCloud+ 获得更高的使用限额。苹果已在 iOS 27.3、iPadOS 27.3 和 macOS 27.3 测试版中加入相关机制。根据目前发现的内容，每台设备每天都将获得一定数量的免费 AI 使用额度。当免费额度耗尽后，用户可以订阅 iCloud+ 获得额外使用次数，也可以等待次日额度重置。此次受到额度限制的功能主要包括四类：依赖云端处理的复杂 Siri AI 请求，例如结合个人信息判断何时出门才能准时抵达目的地；图乐园（Image Playground）图像生成与编辑功能，以及照片应用中的 Clean Up（清理）、Extend（扩展）和 Spatial Reframing（空间重新构图）；依赖 AFM Cloud 和 AFM Cloud Pro 的快捷指令自动化工作流；以及第三方应用通过苹果基础模型在 Private Cloud Compute 中运行的 AI 功能。IT之家提醒，日常 Siri 指令不会受到影响，例如设置 30 分钟计时器、发送短信等单步骤请求仍可免费使用。苹果此次主要限制需要服务器处理的复杂 AI 操作。iCloud+ 现有订阅方案将提供不同等级的 AI 使用额度提升，订阅价格暂时不会调整：50GB（免费）：不增加 AI 使用额度。200GB：最高提升至免费额度的 2 倍，月费 2.99 美元（现汇率约合 20 元人民币）。2TB：最高提升至 5 倍，月费 9.99 美元（现汇率约合 66.7 元人民币）。6TB：最高提升至 10 倍，月费 29.99 美元（现汇率约合 200.3 元人民币）。12TB：最高提升至 20 倍，月费 59.99 美元（现汇率约合 400.6 元人民币）。苹果设备会优先消耗每日免费额度，达到上限后才开始使用 iCloud+ 提供的额外额度。免费额度按照设备分别计算，而非按照 Apple 账户计算，且不会累积到下一天。对于加入 iCloud+ 家庭共享的用户，家庭成员将共同使用订阅方案提供的额外 AI 额度，按照先到先得的方式分配。每日额度预计在用户所在时区午夜左右重置；家庭共享方案则以购买订阅者所在时区为准。苹果还将针对不同功能类别分别设置使用上限，具体额度会根据功能类型、请求复杂程度以及系统负载进行调整。用户接近使用上限时会收到提醒，额度耗尽后可以选择等待重置或通过 iCloud+ 获得更多使用次数。MacRumors 指出，苹果目前尚未提供超出 12TB iCloud+ 方案的额外 AI 使用额度选项。相关机制仍处于测试阶段，最终规则及具体额度可能发生变化。相关阅读：《华为小艺 AI 会员正式上线：体验版赠送 200 积分、49 元起含 1000 积分，Work 订阅用户可 0 元升级》

articles.content: IT之家 11 月 17 日消息，CNBC 今天（11 月 17 日）发布博文，援引一名知情人士透露信息，英伟达董事会目前没有考虑让黄仁勋重新担任首席执行官，也未就其回归展开讨论。报道称英伟达董事会的工作重心，目前聚焦推进针对黄仁勋相关行为的调查。报道称，英伟达已聘请 Wachtell Lipton 律师事务所，调查黄仁勋的行为。IT之家此前报道，黄仁勋在承认婚外情、并面临其他涉及员工的恋情报道后，于上周辞去职务，结束了在这家由其创立的公司长达 33 年的 CEO 任期。围绕其是否回归，外界讨论持续升温。《金融时报》此前报道称，黄仁勋曾与支持者讨论复出事宜。不过，Altimeter Capital 的布拉德 · 格斯特纳 16 日向 CNBC 表示，黄仁勋没有与他讨论回归。与此同时，一项呼吁黄仁勋复职的网络请愿已获得约 18 万个签名，马斯克、Y Combinator 首席执行官陈嘉兴及 Epic Games 首席执行官蒂姆 · 斯威尼等科技界人士也表达了支持。美国总统特朗普 16 日表示，对黄仁勋回归持开放态度。

articles.title: 问界新 M8 率先进驻 AITO 用户中心，华为终端门店停止接单
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 17 日消息，据界面新闻昨日报道，刚刚上市的问界新 M8 已经进入 AITO 问界用户中心，开放预订和试驾。部分华为终端门店尚未摆放这款新车，其中一家门店已经停止接收问界订单。一家华为终端门店内负责汽车销售的人员称，9 月底问界的车型已经撤出这家门店，该店已不负责问界销售，也不能接收问界订单。北京另一家华为终端门店仍有摆放问界 M7 和 M9，销售人员暂不清楚新 M8 的到店时间。公开报道显示，AITO 问界用户中心由赛力斯与经销商集团合作建设，纳入赛力斯经销体系，能够负责问界产品的试驾、销售、交付和售后等全套流程。一家 AITO 问界用户中心的工作人员透露，新 M8 已到店十余天，时间早于上市发布会，后续新增用户中心将更多由赛力斯及其经销商体系推进。销售渠道的变化与赛力斯、华为新一阶段的合作分工同步展开。9 月 15 日，问界宣布合作机制调整，产品定义、产品设计、品牌营销、渠道零售和服务体系由赛力斯主导，华为终端参与赋能。双方同时确认，问界继续留在鸿蒙智行合作框架内，用户既有权益及后续服务不受影响。IT之家此前报道，华为 9 月 30 日与赛力斯在深圳签署面向新五年的合作协议，并于次日对外公布。双方将联合组建问界业务专属团队，继续以“专属专营”方式推进问界业务。11 月 13 日，这款新车首次选择在重庆赛力斯超级工厂发布。华为终端 BG 董事长余承东与赛力斯集团董事长张兴海共同出席发布会，华为终端 BG CEO 何刚负责新 M8 的产品介绍。余承东在发布会上表示，华为继续主导问界的核心技术、产品定义、产品设计和质量流程，赛力斯负责整车制造、研发工程实施、营销、销售、服务和升级维护。双方共同研发、联合设计，并全面参与对方主导的工作。AITO 问界用户中心的工作人员介绍，双方公布新的五年合作后，门店咨询和订单逐步恢复，新 M8 上市后该店 3 天收到 50 余个订单。根据问界官方披露，问界新 M8 上市 72 小时，大定数超过 1.1 万台。相关阅读：《鸿蒙智行问界新 M8 正式上市，37.98 万-46.98 万元》

articles.title: 让你随时欣赏 Game Boy 卡带里的游戏原声音乐，Retro Song Bird 音箱现身众筹
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 17 日消息，一款名为 Retro Song Bird 的音箱近日现身 Kickstarter 众筹平台，售价 79 美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 527.6 元人民币）。这款产品顶部带有一个 Game Boy 游戏卡带槽，可以让玩家随时欣赏《宝可梦红／绿》《牧场物语 GB》《超级咚奇刚》等经典游戏的原声音乐。据介绍，Retro Song Bird 是一款内置 Game Boy 卡带插槽和模拟器的音箱，可以播放 1900 多款支持游戏的原声音乐。同时该产品内置 3.5mm 接口和 USB-C 接口，可连接耳机、调音台等设备。连接到调音台时，设备可以提供四个独立音频通道，让用户能够直接对游戏音乐进行重新混音。此外，该设备还能够连接至电脑，使用户可以复制卡带内的游戏存档，或直接 Dump 完整的 ROM 文件。它还可以搭配 Game Boy Camera 卡带变成复古网络摄像头，最高分辨率 128 × 112 像素、支持 4 级灰度画面。

articles.title: 做 App 副业的最佳 AI 助手：谷歌推出系列工具，瞄准最头疼的变现环节
articles.content: IT之家 11 月 17 日消息，谷歌昨日（11 月 16 日）发布博文，宣布为旗下移动应用广告平台 AdMob 引入新一批 AI 工具，包括对话助手 Ask AdMob 以及面向 AI 编程助手的 AdMob 智能体技能，帮助开发者简化广告接入、排查配置问题，并寻找增加广告收入的机会。Ask AdMob 基于 Gemini 构建，将直接嵌入开发者的 AdMob 账户。按照谷歌的介绍，开发者可以像咨询产品专家一样与它对话，检查广告设置、查找集成错误，或获取收入优化建议。它还支持通过自然语言设置品牌安全规则，减少手动调整广告限制的操作。另一部分工具则着眼于编程环节。AdMob 智能体技能提供预先编写并经过测试的操作指南，让开发者使用的 AI 编程助手能够协助接入广告、迁移至新版广告软件开发工具包，以及检查代码实现是否正确。谷歌还在开发 MCP 服务器，未来可连接开发环境与 AdMob 账户，支持读取账户数据、创建广告单元和管理广告聚合设置。上线节奏方面，智能体技能已可使用；Ask AdMob 计划在未来数月启动测试，MCP 服务器处于早期测试阶段，预计 2027 年初扩大测试范围。

articles.title: "Proof of use" as a requirement for open source contributions?
articles.content:
As an open source maintainer, I get a lot of AI slop PRs. Some of these have genuine value. Most address edge cases that almost never occur in real life. It's not that they're not fixing real problems, it's that they're fixing problems that nobody is ever likely to encounter.
I'm experimenting with "proof of use" as a requirement for submissions. Specifically, you need to show me that your project that depends on my project before I'll look at your PR.
"Proof of use" can be an existing open source project that imports mine (show me the git history!) or a clear description starting with "in our closed source project in production, we found that...".
The specific problem that I want to address is ensuring that contributions from people genuinely depending on my software are handled, while filtering out the OpenClaw/Github green square farming/drive-by LLM noise.
What are lobste.rs's thoughts on this?

articles.content: IT之家 11 月 17 日消息，英伟达今日在 SC26 大会发布 Rubin HPC GPU，基于 Vera Rubin 平台打造，专为科学研究、工程设计、数据分析仿真计算等工作设计。IT之家从英伟达新闻稿获悉，Rubin HPC GPU 配备创纪录的 CUDA 核心，单 GPU 的 CUDA 数超过 5 万个。作为对比，RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 的 CUDA 数量是 24,064 个，GeForce RTX 5090 为 21,760 个。同时该 GPU 还具备稀疏数据加速能力，可持续为计算核心提供数据，并支持第七代 NVIDIA NVLink 互连技术，助力多 GPU 的高速数据传输。Rubin HPC GPU 还针对仿真计算进行均衡化设计，它能够持续为 GPU 的 CUDA 核心提供数据，使 GPU 核心能够专注于计算，而不是等待数据传输。官方列出的适用计算模式涵盖稀疏矩阵运算、模板计算、排序和归约，这些操作常见于气候建模、基因组分析、工程设计和金融风险计算等任务。此外，Rubin HPC 预计将于 2028 年上市，官方暂未公布详细参数。

articles.title: 李飞飞最新 CoRL2026 演讲实录：从「橱柜模型」到世界模型，机器人需要什么样的 AI ？
articles.content: 时隔两年，World Labs 的工作已经完全不同了。    作者丨齐铖湧    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       2026年11月，CoRL（机器人学习顶会）在奥斯汀开幕。这一届的演讲嘉宾，有一个无法回避的名字，李飞飞。斯坦福教授、ImageNet发起者、World Labs创始人。就在本届CoRL之前，World Labs被AMD收购的消息正在圈内发酵，她即将出任AMD首席科学家。这届CoRL现场，她不仅全面介绍了World Labs最近的工作和她的行业观点，还邀请AMD苏妈参与了对话圆桌，某种意义上，这是她的"AMD首秀"。为她做开场介绍的，是她的学生、本届CoRL组织者之一Yuke（朱玉可）。他讲了一个细节：毕业典礼上，李飞飞对他说，“你在我的实验室时是我的学生，但从今往后，你是我的朋友。”这场演讲的正式主角，是World Labs与斯坦福团队研发的新模型Atlas：一个统一的生成与重建世界模型。以下是AI科技评论带来的现场实录。▎《Atlas：A Unified World Model for Generation and Reconstruction》▎分享者：李飞飞非常荣幸受邀来到CoRL，尤其是有好几位我的前学生都是组织者。你们干得真棒，我知道，因为我很多论文和工作坊提案都被你们拒了。（全场笑）向CoRL致敬。今天我想分享我们实验室最近开发的一个模型，叫Atlas：一个统一的生成与重建世界模型。既然在CoRL，就先从机器人学的动机讲起。机器人领域最近变化很大，但不管我们用什么方法，机器人要解决的根本问题是：给定世界状态、给定目标、给定机器人，每一个时刻下一步该做什么？大体上，机器人需要解决几个问题：第一，理解和表示世界的状态，用隐式还是显式可以讨论，但"理解"本身很重要；第二，预测有后果的动作，并加以规划。雷峰网最后，数据永远是难题。机器人是典型的长尾问题，成功部署极其受限，所以我们总希望能通过尽可能多地模拟不同环境来补充真实数据，用于训练和评估。无论用什么方法，这三个问题在机器人学里都依然重要。而它们恰好对应世界模型要解决的问题：理解环境，对应渲染；预测动作后果，对应规划；模拟世界状态，对应仿真。渲染、规划与仿真，世界模型的三大维度我不想教条地说它们完全独立，实际上它们在很多方面可以统一、彼此衔接，这些都是这个领域最前沿、最令人兴奋的方向。今天我要专门讲的Atlas，主要解决渲染和仿真问题，尤其是模拟世界的几何以及3D/4D动态。简而言之，Atlas是一个从零训练的自回归基础模型，单一模型，接收多模态输入，文本、图像、视频、深度信号、灰度框（graybox）或3D结构信号。它输出像素帧；不仅生成时空上漂亮的帧，还能合成新视角，从而实现高精度、高保真的3D重建。Atlas：聚焦于渲染和仿真先回顾一点历史。计算机视觉有两个非常重要的问题，研究者们花了几代人的时间去理解。一是3D重建问题，从经典的"Building Rome in a Day"到最近的NeRF类神经渲染工作，根本问题是：给定不同相机位姿下的图像，构建符合真实世界的3D世界。大多数方法需要大量带位姿的图像；位姿覆盖不足时，重建出的区域就充满不确定性。经典三维重建的问题所在另一条线是生成式AI。扩散架构天然适合多视角生成的探索，让我们离"生成+重建"越来越近。已有不少出色工作尝试联合去噪多个视角来保持空间一致性，但总体结果有限：空间一致性难维持，且每次去噪只对应固定目标视角，计算昂贵、无法实时。经典三维重建很难维持空间一致性改变视角或实时运行，计算成本太高Atlas延续这条思路，试图用一个模型架构、一套训练配方，把生成与重建统一在同一个屋檐下。它是这样做的，首先是一个极端：给定多张图像，Atlas做重建；图像足够多时，做稠密重建，

articles.title: 李飞飞对话苏姿丰：AMD 收购后首次同台，CoRL 现场谈算力、机器人与「这个时代最大的失误」
articles.content: 一场横跨科研、经济、AI、社会话题、算力未来的女性对话。    作者丨齐铖湧    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       2026年11月，奥斯汀，CoRL 2026的台下坐满了机器人研究者。台上三把椅子，两位嘉宾，左边是即将出任AMD首席科学家的李飞飞，右边是AMD CEO苏姿丰。这是AMD收购World Labs消息传出后，两人的首次公开同台，也是李飞飞以"AMD首席科学家"身份，第一次面对整个机器人学术社区。对话没有客套太久。李飞飞直接把话题引向了敏感区域：公共部门的算力"饥饿"，是"这个历史最重要时刻最大的失误之一"。大学和非营利机构拿不到卡，下一代研究者怎么训练？蓝天式的好奇心驱动研究怎么做？她看向苏姿丰，AMD正在建设"以吉瓦计"的算力，academia 能不能真的分到一杯羹？在苏姿丰看来："把一部分专门留给长期研究、留给大学，绝对是我们工作的一部分。"但她同时也划定边界：机器人不是单靠一个端到端大模型就能啃下来的，未来需要"各种形态、各种规模"的算力，硬件、软件、系统必须协同优化。不止如此，这场对话里还包含很多探讨，比如机器人会不会被基础模型一口吃掉？AGI真的只差"一分钟"了吗？在这个连PhD都要被AI重新定义的时代，做学术还有没有意义？以下是AI科技评论带来的完整对话实录。李飞飞、苏姿丰（Lisa Su）和主持人Peter Stone（从左往右）01物理 AI 带来的机会：数千亿美元量级Peter Stone： 谢谢二位，Lisa、Fei-Fei，来到CoRL。精彩的演讲，那个视频（Atlas最新成果）我们明天都等着看，大家现在都坐不住了。接下来大约半小时，我们会从Slido（现场提问平台）上取问题，我也会混入一些事先准备的问题。Lisa、Fei-Fei，你们现在和机器人学习社区同台。我们已经听说了AMD收购World Labs的事（正在进行中），Fei-Fei刚才也讲了世界模型和前方的巨大机会。Lisa，我先问你：AMD一直从数据中心到边缘和嵌入式系统，在整个AI栈上投资。Peter Stone： 展望机器人和物理AI，你认为AMD最大的机会在哪里？World Labs如何融入这个更大的战略？苏姿丰： 谢谢Peter，也谢谢大家让我来。Fei-Fei邀请我来"蹭会"，希望没关系。欢迎大家来到奥斯汀。我认为这是AI极其激动人心的时刻。回顾我们迄今取得的所有进展，我们其实还处在可能性的非常早期的阶段（very early innings）。物理AI、尤其是机器人，是巨大的机会，对我们来说，未来几年这是数千亿美元量级的机遇。关键在于，你必须真正理解物理、模型和整个环境。所以我们非常高兴Fei-Fei和World Labs团队加入AMD。苏姿丰： 除了她是超级明星之外，我们能不能就直说她是超级明星？（全场笑）在我们这个行业，硬件优化要持续很多年，你对工作负载了解得越多、越清楚它要往哪走，就越好。我一直说的硬件、软件、系统协同优化的愿景，放在机器人上尤为适用。未来5到10年，这将是极其重要的领域。更重要的是，对整个AMD生态而言，我们非常希望把AMD的开放生态扩展到在座的整个机器人社区。谢谢大家给我几分钟。Peter Stone： 太好了。我们能看出她是超级明星，因为她是Yuke和Roberto的博士和博后导师，正是他们帮忙促成了这届大会，除此之外她还有很多成功的学生。Fei-Fei，换你。从你的角度，加入AMD如何扩展World Labs能做的事？你刚阐述了世界模型的愿景，这个结合让你们接下来能构建什么？对机器人社区意味着什么？李飞飞： 首先，来到奥斯汀太好了

articles.title: When Should LLM Agents Forget? Memory Filtering Under Query-Critical Resolver Errors
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17338v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM memory systems often delete facts classified as stale. We show that this hard-filtering step can reduce downstream accuracy when resolver errors delete query-critical facts. Across three models, a controlled sensitivity intervention moves hard-drop from gains of +0.186 to +0.230 at perfect resolution to losses of -0.176 to -0.181 at the lowest tested reliability. Paired targeted interventions show that false-drop causes significantly greater degradation than false-keep, while a non-deleting baseline can still fail when incorrect labels steer generation. On a frozen 102/102 calibration/test split, a simple deployment-matched gate reaches 0.655 accuracy versus 0.641 for always hard-drop and 0.662 for test-informed oracle selection. Global-accuracy crossovers require gold labels and are model- and task-specific diagnostics, not deployment thresholds. articles.title: Does the Ranking Hold? A Practitioner-Facing Audit of Hallucination Detectors on Small, Quantized, On-Device LLMs
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17339v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Hallucination detection for large language models is dominated by methods evaluated on 7B-70B research models with abundant sampling budgets and exact-match or ROUGE correctness labels. The small models practitioners actually ship on-device, Phi-3-mini, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, and Gemma-2-2B-Instruct, typically at 4-bit precision, sit outside this evidence base. We present a reproducible one-GPU audit of four detectors spanning three paradigms: length-normalized token-margin calibration, a lexical n-gram baseline, and two sampling-based consistency methods (semantic entropy and SelfCheckGPT-NLI) on two small open instruction-tuned models (Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct) loaded at 4-bit NF4 quantization on a single Colab T4 GPU, evaluated on closed-book TriviaQA. articles.title: LoRAWeaver: Directional Adapter Routing in LoRA Representation Space
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17340v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models are expensive to update through full retraining. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning reduces the cost of adaptation, but repeated adaptation creates a growing pool of task-specific LoRA adapters. This pool complicates adapter selection during inference. Existing routing and encoder-based methods often require retraining when new adapters are added, which limits their use in dynamic settings. This paper treats adapter routing as a representation alignment problem in the adapter-output space. The proposed training-free method selects adapters by matching adapter-conditioned query representations against task prototypes using cosine similarity. Experiments with LLaMA-2-7B and LLaMA-2-13B on a 48-task FLAN-v2 benchmark and on out-of-distribution tasks show that the method outperforms training-free baselines in the cross-task setting and approaches a trained retrieval encoder without learning a router. articles.title: Tabular Population Priors as Structured Retrieval for EHR Medication Set Prediction
articles.content:

Abstract: Medication prediction from electronic health records is a fixed vocabulary structured prediction problem, yet recent clinical RAG systems often treat it like open ended case based reasoning: retrieve similar patient admissions and ask an LLM to infer a medication set. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17495v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) is currently a valuable tool for overseeing AI models, but some architectural shifts could significantly reduce CoT monitorability. We operationalize a measure that serves as a proxy for the amount of unverbalized serial cognition a model can perform, as a specific instantiation of the notion of opaque serial depth: roughly, the length of the longest path through a model's computation that does not pass through an interpretable bottleneck. Our main contribution is a particular standard for what counts as such a bottleneck. We define natural-language-rooted (NL-rooted) nodes as nodes that were initialized from a pre-training prior to produce human-understandable outputs, whose output space has not been expanded beyond that prior, and whose outputs the model has not been modified to interpret as a different type of data. Abstract: Recommendation and Ranking (R&R) models, particularly in digital advertising, require massive inference throughput but exhibit extreme sensitivity to precision loss. Unlike Large Language Models (LLMs) that frequently tolerate quantization-induced accuracy drops of 1% or more, production-grade R&R models enforce a stringent launch bar: model quality must remain within a 0.01% Normalized Entropy (NE) margin relative to the baseline, which commonly uses FP16 or FP32. Abstract: A small labelled dataset is memorized long before the training budget runs out, and the one-hot labels that remain to be fitted then mostly sharpen confidence. Model annealing spends the rest of the budget on review and consolidation, relearning from the network's own knowledge. Training is divided into episodes whose learning rate is raised again and cooled, every cooled state joins a memory of past selves, and each new episode learns from the labels, from the tempered predictions of this memory, and from adversarial dreams sought where student and memory disagree most. Abstract: Conductors are critical for the performance of an orchestra even though they do not emit sound. Basic research and clinical studies in the last decade are revealing that astrocytes may be the "conductors" of the "orchestra" that is the brain network: astrocytes make up approximately $50\%$ of all brain cells but do not emit electrical signals. Here we consider the implications of these discoveries for brain-inspired machine learning (ML), where analogy is typically drawn between neurons and their electrical interactions. articles.content:

Abstract: Governments are writing rules for artificial intelligence that decide what counts as an automated decision or a harm, often before the people they affect have a chance to question them. We introduce AI-Voyager, a public-interest system for human-AI civic reasoning, in which people and AI work together to understand, contest and shape the rules that govern AI. A resident can find their city's rules on AI in hiring or upload their country's AI strategy, read it as an affected worker would, open the passage behind any answer, and draft a revision. Abstract: Behavioral clusters learned over user or item interactions drift as behavior evolves: some fragment into sub-behaviors, some converge, some disappear, and new patterns emerge. Abstract: Autonomous agents now run for hundreds of steps with little or no human supervision. In practice, practitioners use runtime monitors such as turn limits and keyword filters to decide when a run should be stopped, upgraded, or assisted. Abstract: The appropriate governing norms and principles for the alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) often depend on cultural context and deployment application. However, most alignment techniques focus on training models to conform to human preferences or constitutional principles specified at training time and subsequently fixed. Abstract: Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) is the standard distance for similarity search over time series that are misaligned in time, but its cost is quadratic in the series length and lower bounds often prune few candidates, so search over large collections of long series is slow. Abstract: AI agents are increasingly equipped with persistence toward task completion to run delegated work autonomously for long periods, under many unstated constraints from internal documents and other people's authority. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17478v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Processing-in-memory (PIM) has been proposed as an alternative computing paradigm for training Deep Neural Networks, including Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). Despite these advancements, training GNN workloads on PIM devices necessitates off-chip memory access. This off-chip access is expensive in terms of performance and energy, thereby impacting the overall energy efficiency of the training process on PIM platforms. In this paper, we propose a novel hybrid training framework called ERGo that automatically switches from a full-parameter phase to a parameter-efficient phase during the training process with negligible loss in predictive accuracy. The parameter-efficient phase employs low-rank representations of GNN weights, effectively reducing the number of trainable parameters. articles.title: SURFACE: Preference Distribution Matching on Pareto Fronts via Scalarization Steering
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17484v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Constructing a finite Pareto representation requires allocating a limited number of solutions across the Pareto front (PF). A desired preference distribution specifies this allocation by assigning more solutions to some PF regions and fewer to others. Scalarization generates Pareto solutions by varying objective weights and solving single-objective problems. articles.title: Identifying Latent Neural Dynamics with Recognition-Parametrised Gaussian Process Dynamical Systems
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17487v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Neural circuits are densely interconnected systems, and many neural computations are thought to be mediated by the dynamical evolution of activity within these recurrent networks, a hypothesis often referred to as "computation through dynamics". Under this view, understanding computation within real neural populations depends on building models of the dynamical rules governing the temporal evolution of recorded high-dimensional neural activity. Most commonly, such models depend on explicit generative parameterisations of (i) the (nonlinear) intrinsic dynamical flow field and stochasticity, (ii) the (nonlinear) mapping from dynamical state to neuronal activity, and (iii) the variability of individual neural responses given that dynamical state. articles.title: PF-Exec: Large-Scale UAV Relay Load Balancing with an Anchored Potential Direction Decider and a Per-Dimension Gain-Learning Executor
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17492v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Relay load balancing in large-scale UAV networks requires joint decisions on association, bandwidth, power and hovering position, while the dimension grows with the number of UAVs and each UAV sees only its local state. This paper splits the decision into two layers. An anchored potential direction decider emits a closed-form target at every instant and returns its direction only. A gain-learning executor maps a local observation into a positive gain per dimension, composes gain and target, and clips the action against the physical single-step bound; the two layers form PF-Exec. The unit gain is the default start, so the executor reduces to the pure potential policy before training. The load is first-order homogeneous in bandwidth, making the bandwidth target closed form, and the position target is the demand-weighted centroid of the served users. articles.title: Adversarially Batched Online Learning
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17500v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We introduce adversarially batched online learning, where the learner may update its decision rule only at a restricted set of time steps. Equivalently, the time horizon is partitioned into batches, within which the learner must use a fixed policy. We study this model for four canonical problems: stochastic bandits, online convex optimization, prediction with expert advice, and adversarial bandits. For stochastic bandits, we identify a universal complexity measure based on relative batch growth and establish both gap-dependent and gap-independent regret bounds. We show that the multiplicative penalty relative to the standard gap-dependent complexity can grow superlinearly in batch hardness. For the remaining three, we show that the optimal regret is tightly characterized by the 2-norm of the batch-length sequence. articles.title: A Synthetic Benchmark for Target-Centric Causal Discovery in Industrial Processes
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17556v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Causal discovery promises to find which recorded variables drive a process target such as product quality, yield or energy use. Process data with known causes are rare, and in existing benchmarks the difficulty of identifying the causes of a target is either fixed by the recorded data or set for the whole graph. We present a synthetic benchmark for target-centric causal discovery in industrial processes. Its generator is a two-level structural causal model inspired by batch production, assembled from components that each model one phenomenon of process data, such as a control loop or a delayed effect. The graph is built around the target: without sensor error, every non-cause can be distinguished from the direct causes by conditioning on them or by time order. articles.title: Generative Design with Real-time Physics Explainability: Towards Product Definition in the Age of AI
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17560v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In this article, we explore opportunities from using generative AI in mechanical engineering. On the one hand, generative methods based on invertible neural networks have been recently proposed for the solution of inverse design problems, allowing to infer design parameters from performance labels. On the other hand, generative AI models have shown that they can act as real time capable surrogates for physics based simulations. Here we suggest that these two streams should be combined in a unified framework, where INN are used to control the design process from the customer requirements perspective and the generative simulation of the systems physics adds a layer of explainability, why the proposed design fulfils the requirements. As generative design is prone to hallucinations, we propose uncertainty quantification to fend off physically infeasible requests. Finally, validation with classical tools is a requirement for generative design

articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17576v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Binary neural networks (BNNs) reduce model storage and replace many arithmetic operations with efficient bitwise computations, but the single-sign activation limits their representational capacity. Each preactivation direction is compared with one threshold and reduced to one of two values, discarding variation within each sign region. We propose \textbf{BiTE} (Branch-Preserving Binary Threshold Expansion), which evaluates each feature direction against $K$ ordered thresholds and retains the resulting binary responses as separate inputs to the following learned operator. BiTE can distinguish up to $K+1$ ordered activation states while allowing the following operator to learn a separate transformation for each threshold response. It also enables a controllable trade-off between the number of independently constructed feature directions and the number of ordered responses extracted from each direction. articles.title: Fair and Efficient Distributed EV Charging Coordination Using Threshold Cryptography and Machine Learning
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17577v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Distributed coordination of electric vehicle (EV) charging with the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) keeps EV constraints private but assumes that every participant follows the algorithm. This assumption fails in practice, where a biased operator or a man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacker can send inconsistent signals to different EVs, and compromised EVs can deviate from their prescribed updates. We first prove that attacks by such arbitrarily malicious, i.e., Byzantine, participants do not prevent convergence and therefore remain undetected, and derive the most damaging attack in closed form. We then propose a framework that combines a threshold-signed broadcast with upload recomputation, which detects every deviation without false alarms at linear instead of quadratic communication cost. articles.title: LightTAR: Light and Fast Target-Aware Representations for Multimodal Tabular Learning
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17600v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Multimodal tabular learning involves classification and regression on tables combining structured numerical and categorical features with unstructured text and images. These unstructured fields are commonly represented by pretrained encoder embeddings reduced with principal component analysis (PCA). This reduction prioritizes input variance but may overlook information relevant to predicting the target. We introduce LightTAR, a simple, inexpensive method that adapts dimensionality reduction to the prediction task. LightTAR augments the standard PCA representation with a few target-aware features extracted jointly from the final and an intermediate encoder layer using regularized partial least squares (PLS). We evaluate LightTAR with 21 tabular models, including tree ensembles, neural networks, and tabular foundation models. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17603v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: KL-regularized reinforcement learning is the objective behind RL fine-tuning of language models, and its data are often collected by the reference policy itself. However, beyond bandits and deterministic transitions, little is known about how much offline data it needs. In this work, we study finite discounted Markov decision processes with unknown stochastic transitions, $K$ state-action pairs and effective horizon $H$. For data that cover the regularized optimum with concentrability $C\geq 4$, every estimator needs $\Omega(KCH^3/(\epsilon\max\{\epsilon,\beta\}))$ samples on some instances when $\epsilon$ is small, where $\beta$ is the temperature. Under a fixed design, pessimistic soft value iteration with a variance-aware penalty attains this rate with high probability, up to logarithmic factors, when $\beta\geq 1.4H$. articles.title: Neural Simulation-Based Inference for Computational Cognitive Models: A Tutorial
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17608v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Computational cognitive modeling is an increasingly essential methodology to elucidate the mechanisms underlying human and animal cognition. By fitting models to empirical data, researchers can perform parameter estimation, model comparison, and model-based neural analyses to assess competing theories, quantify individual differences, and investigate neural representations. Typically, fitting these models relies on likelihood-dependent methods (e.g., Maximum likelihood estimation or hierarchical Bayesian methods). However, for many reasonable cognitive models, computing the likelihood is computationally intractable, in which case these methods become inadequate. This substantially limits the range of theories that researchers can investigate. articles.title: Tracing Knowledge and Reasoning in LLM
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17461v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Current evaluations of Large Language Models (LLMs) report performance at the dataset or task level, revealing what a model achieves but offering little insight into the internal processing associated with its performance. We propose a task-centric framework for characterising the model-internal processing elicited by a benchmark. It combines attention- and activation-based signals with representation-based measures to characterise benchmarks spanning a continuum from retrieval-dominant to reasoning-dominant and to surface failure modes that task-level scores conceal. We evaluate 16 LLMs across 24 diverse benchmarks and conduct targeted internal-state analyses on representative models and tasks, observing systematic differences in processing between knowledge-centric and reasoning-centric tasks. articles.title: Poetry 'resurrection' from LLMs
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17464v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In an era where linguistic creativity is challenged by algorithmic authorship, we pose a provocative question: can artificial intelligence (AI) write an infinite poem? We set up two experiments to investigate the quantitative and qualitative output produced by AI utilizing couplets that evidence a poetic relationship between end words, the only variation in a strict anaphoric, litany structure. Our results show that while AI can generate interesting pairings, it still falls short of human-level creativity and understanding of poetic relationships. We offer commentary and a brief survey of the field of computational poetry experiments, tracing back authorial intention and distinctions of 'natural' and 'artificial' poetry, as well as justifying why couplet form is suited to testing AI's poetic output. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17481v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Activation steering influences a language model's behaviour by adding a steering vector to its residual stream during generation, but it requires white-box access to modify the hidden states at every generation step. We introduce ActGCG, a modification of Greedy Coordinate Gradient which optimises a suffix to match the target activations obtained by adding a steering vector to the residual stream. We further introduce universal suffixes trained across many prompts at once, a model-translation step that rewrites the suffix into human-readable text midway through optimisation, and a soft-suffix variant to remove the discrete token space constraint. We study two behaviours: steering a model to answer in German, and anti-refusal steering for jailbreaking. articles.title: Benchmarks Don't Talk Back: Learning Through Self-Disagreement
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17563v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: A benchmark usually measures a language model alone with a question, and deployment rarely looks like that: answers get contested, and models give up correct ones under counter-reasoning that is itself wrong. We show that what fails there is not a shortfall of accuracy but a capability in its own right -- knowing when to hold a position and when to yield to a better one -- which we call dialectical competence. It stands on first-answer accuracy without following from it: a model can be made materially better at answering and no better at this, and training for accuracy alone can drift against it. Nor can it be bought at inference, by self-reflection or by sampling more. Taking a cue from the dialectical tradition in philosophy, in which productive opposition arises within a position rather than being imposed on it from outside, we hypothesize that this capability can be trained from opposition the model supplies itself. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17573v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Cameroon Pidgin English (a West African Pidgin English variety) and Camfranglais are widely used in Cameroon, yet to our knowledge, neither has a dedicated spoken Natural Language Inference (NLI) resource. We introduce CamSpokenNLI, a pilot dataset of 114 scenario-matched spoken NLI items in each variety (228 in total), recorded by one native speaker from Buea. Each item pairs premise audio and text with a hypothesis, an NLI label, and English glosses. The author assigned labels, so the dataset is an exploratory resource rather than a mature benchmark. The NLI experiments use the reference text; the audio is evaluated separately. XLM-RoBERTa baselines with five-fold item-level cross-validation reach 44.7% on Pidgin and 46.2% on Camfranglais (chance 33.3%). articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17589v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Small open-weight language models can run crowd decision-making (CDM) on an institution's own infrastructure, which keeps the checkpoint, the inference settings and the opinions under its control. Their judgements vary across repeated queries; whether repeating and aggregating them, often through the 2-tuple linguistic representation, settles the decision rather than the labels is untested. Five open-weight models of 8-36B total parameters on one consumer GPU and a hosted reference classify 474 TripAdvisor reviews of four London restaurants ten times each; three open-weight models repeat the protocol on 600 reviews of twelve Madrid restaurants. Continuous evaluations preserve resolution: snapping each review leaves 5 distinct values against 21-65, and snapping at every level at most two collective values. articles.title: What Do Multilingual Self-Supervised Speech Encoders Know About Sentence Meaning?
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17686v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Self-supervised speech models (S3Ms) have been scaled up to thousands of languages and millions of hours of audio, yet little is known about how these models structure semantic knowledge across languages. In this work, we probe sentence-level semantics in massively multilingual S3Ms across 76 languages, using linear maps from frozen speech representations into a frozen text embedding space, evaluated by cross-modal retrieval. Sentence meaning is linearly accessible but highly uneven across languages and resource tiers. Cross-lingual probes can match language-specific probes on languages never seen in probe training, but per-model monolingual decodability does not predict transfer. articles.title: See Every Block Once: Variance-Reduced Post-Training for Masked Diffusion Language Models
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17754v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Policy gradient methods are widely used to align large language model outputs with human preferences, but the log-likelihoods they require cannot be directly computed in Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs). MDLM post-training therefore relies on a surrogate objective based on the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO), and recent work estimates a blockwise variant of this objective via Monte Carlo methods to support blockwise generation. However, existing estimation schemes randomly sample the block index, so they may evaluate the same block more than once and leave some blocks unevaluated. This introduces variance arising from block selection into the estimates. In this work, we propose a full-block estimator that evaluates every block exactly once and averages the results. articles.title: GDP.xlsx: Benchmarking Frontier Models on Professional Workbooks
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17766v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We introduce GDP_xlsx, a benchmark of 70 realistic workplace requests written by professionals in 13 domains, each paired with an expert rubric of binary criteria and with the complete workbook or CSV file it refers to. Together the files hold 2.18 million populated cells, and the rubrics 791 criteria. Agents work in a container with spreadsheet tools, and an agentic judge that can open the file applies the rubric. Completeness and exclusivity criteria require set-valued answers to be found in full and with nothing extra. We rank models by strict pass@1, the share of attempts that meet every criterion. Across 20 model configurations, including frontier models from Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI, the top-scoring one, Gemini 4 Argon, passes only 38.3% of attempts, and the median score is 19.3%, leaving wide headroom. articles.title: Activation Steering the Nan-Shan in Typhoon
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17768v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Typhoon is an audiovisual installation based on Joseph Conrad's novella, in which Captain MacWhirr steers the steamer Nan-Shan directly into and through a catastrophic storm. The novella is a study of what happens when the scale of a phenomenon exceeds the practical and conceptual frameworks available to comprehend it and of the paralysis that sometimes follows a demand for action in such overwhelming circumstances. We chose the text of Typhoon to reflect on human culture's current AI moment. We prompt a large language model, seeded with Conrad's original language, to feed endlessly on its own output, and explore when and how the text becomes increasingly alien and unwieldy as time progresses, including deviations from the narrative, digressions into the model's own instructions and thinking, and long periods of incoherent rumination. articles.title: LuthorSQL: A One-Pass Text-to-SQL Model as System 1 for a Slower LLM Agent
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17780v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Frontier LLM agents that query databases with tools are among the most accurate text-to-SQL systems, but per-query calls to a hosted model are slow, costly, and expose sensitive organizational queries to external APIs. For example, a Claude Opus 5.5 agent serving 10,000 queries a day costs over $70,000 a year at list price. To what extent can local hardware already owned by an organization offload this burden without compromising the agent's accuracy? We present LuthorSQL, a non-autoregressive 7B text-to-SQL model that serves as a rapid System 1 gate for a slower LLM agent (System 2), escalating queries only when uncertain. LuthorSQL makes a single forward pass to predict slot scores over a bounded grammar for query plans, compiles and runs up to 32 candidate plans, and chooses an answer using a trained validator. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17788v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), query rewriting serves as a core interface that aligns user intent with external knowledge bases, and its effectiveness directly determines overall system performance. However, generative retrieval faces three critical challenges in real-world deployment: noisy retrieval feedback, the difficulty of jointly optimizing discrete prompt templates and continuous decoding-control parameters, and the limited generalization of static rewriting strategies under semantically complex scenarios. To address these issues, we propose RAG-FGO, a dynamic optimization framework for generative retrieval strategies. articles.title: CarryOn: Learning What to Keep in Context for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17808v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents can coordinate tools and applications to complete complex, multi-step tasks. As their interaction histories grow, effective context management becomes essential for reliable and efficient execution. Existing methods reduce context through summarization, pruning, or history selection. However, shorter contexts do not necessarily support better decisions: summaries can omit exact details needed for later actions, while retaining entire interactions can carry substantial irrelevant information. We propose CarryOn, a lightweight context manager that pairs compact execution state with fine-grained, source-linked evidence. A learned selector and adaptive retention policy keep relevant evidence available without additional LLM calls for context management. articles.title: AI Reviews Are Biased Towards the Appendix
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17811v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used by reviewers to highlight weaknesses during the reviewing process, and their outputs often shape the reviews that humans submit. Prior work studies how LLM reviews align with human ones, yet we know little about which parts of a paper these models actually criticize. In this work, we investigate 2,000 papers from ACL, EMNLP, COLM, and ICLR, and show that the latest GPT and Claude models draw about 50% or more of their review weaknesses from the appendix. This behavior holds across the API, coding-agent, and web access methods for using LLMs to review a paper. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17834v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: As AI conference submissions grow rapidly, AI reviewers are being considered as an alternative. However, simply imitating human reviewing is problematic because reviewing serves multiple purposes, including evaluating papers' soundness, interestingness, and clarity, the last two of which are subjective. In this work, we focus solely on evaluating soundness, the most important and objective criterion, and define the learning objective as jointly maximizing (1) precision, based on the soundness and substantiveness of review points, and (2) recall, the coverage of high-quality reference review points. Under this problem formulation, we construct a quality-labeled review point dataset, PaperSound-23K, using 1K ICLR submissions and 23K human-written and LLM-generated review points. Abstract: Evaluating grammatical knowledge in language models requires benchmarks that cover diverse linguistic phenomena and are validated against human judgments. We introduce BLiMP-RO, a Romanian minimal-pair benchmark covering 50 grammatical phenomena across ten domains. It comprises 493 linguist-constructed sentence pairs, evaluated by native speakers in five experiments, and 5,942 additional semi-automatically generated, human-validated pairs. arXiv:2611.17931v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In mineral exploration, verifying geological hypotheses relies on designing a variety of geochemical experiments. While large language model (LLM) agents increasingly automate downstream geoscientific data analysis, a crucial upstream capability remains largely unexplored: automated geochemical experimental design, i.e., deciding which experiments to conduct before committing to costly laboratory work. Evaluating this capability of LLM agents is difficult for two reasons. First, geochemical experiments exhibit high methodological diversity and subjectivity: to test the same hypothesis, different geologists may choose different minerals and instruments, so no single protocol can serve as the reference answer. Abstract: Can you trust a finance agent you did not build? We take the reference agent shipped with the Vals Finance Agent Benchmark v2, leave it untuned, and ask four questions a leaderboard score does not answer. Is the score stable? Seven identical runs on 18 questions pass between 105 and 123 of 149 rubric criteria, and the bill varies by up to 17%. When the agent fails, who owns the fix? Abstract: Human Label Variation (HLV) is increasingly recognised as an informative signal that reflects meaningful differences in how people interpret the same input. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17400v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Document-parsing metrics can give high scores to outputs that change important facts and penalize changes that preserve meaning. People can often judge these consequences more easily than they can design a metric to measure them. We introduce a method for developing parsing metrics from severity policies that specify how each error type should affect the score. We express these policies through test scenarios that specify how a metric should behave. We then optimize the metric implementations against these fixed expectations, using coding agents to refine comparison rules, error detectors and weights under human review. This makes stated human priorities an explicit objective of metric design. We apply this method in ParseBench-2, a comprehensive document-parsing benchmark that combines broad capability coverage with metrics calibrated to error severity. Abstract: Low-light conditions severely degrade robotic perception: object detectors trained on daylight imagery are prone to failure under dark and adverse weather conditions that fall outside of their training distribution. Abstract: Object tracking systems estimate the motion of surrounding vehicles by linking detected objects across video frames. In particular, Tracking-By-Detection (TBD) systems combine object detectors with motion prediction and data association to maintain object identities over time. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17585v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Reward models are a core component of modern text-to-image systems, serving as the objective for inference-time selection and RL-based post-training. A key prerequisite is visual understanding: to judge prompt adherence and ground aesthetic preferences, a reward model must bind attributes, resolve relations, and count reliably. We find that widely-used reward models perform poorly on targeted visual reasoning evaluations. Even when starting from strong vision-language backbones, preference fine-tuning erodes these capabilities, and continual-learning baselines fail to mitigate a steep tradeoff between visual reasoning and preference accuracy. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17586v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Self-supervised learning aims to learn meaningful representations from unlabeled data, potentially allowing models to capture subtle anatomical variations across patients and reduce the amount of labeled data needed. Image-based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (I-JEPA) learns by predicting target-region representations from visible context rather than reconstructing pixels. However, its uniform target placement does not account for the anatomical structure of retinal OCT, where retinal tissue occupies only part of each B-scan. We investigate anatomy-guided target selection using image intensity and predicted retinal segmentation while retaining the I-JEPA architecture and latent prediction objective. We compare anatomy-guided rectangular targets, anatomy-shaped targets and coverage-constrained placement with uniform masking, and evaluate the learned representations using linear probing for glaucoma classification on FairVision. Abstract: Contrastive vision-language models such as CLIP are trained to align images and text, not to represent taxonomies. A theoretical characterization of why such hierarchy emerges from a non-hierarchical objective remains open. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17695v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Recovering the complete appearance of occluded objects from a single image is a fundamental problem for scene understanding and image editing. Real-world scenes are challenging due to clutter, complex spatial occlusions, and diverse object categories. Existing methods often struggle when occlusion involves background surfaces or objects that are not explicitly detected, and fail to resolve the cyclic occlusion dependencies that frequently occur in natural scenes. We introduce a training-free, open-world scene deocclusion framework that recovers the full amodal appearance of detected or user-selected objects from a single RGB image, decomposing the scene into depth-ordered RGBA layers that are geometrically plausible, semantically faithful, and visually consistent with the visible scene. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17707v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Pixel losses train image reconstruction networks toward a point statistic of the target distribution, often averaging away fine textures under uncertainty. Perceptual losses alleviate this issue using pretrained features, but those features are inherently domain-specific. We study a random filter loss (RaFL) that compares prediction and target through filters with random weights, avoiding both pretrained features and task-specific loss engineering. RaFL combines random convolutions, random Fourier features, and random wavelet filters, automatically balancing their contributions through gradient-norm matching, eliminating manual loss-weight tuning and grid search. Abstract: Medical visual question answering models can answer correctly without attending to the anatomy that the question names. Abstract: Sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is prone to overfitting because only a limited number of images are available to constrain scene geometry. articles.content:

Abstract: Dense hand contact estimation from a single RGB image is a foundational primitive for dexterous manipulation and 3D interaction analysis. Direct predictors typically decode the entire per-vertex contact map from one shared query, leaving individual vertices ungrounded in the image and smearing contact across adjacent, non-touching surfaces. We present VACO, a vertex-aligned decoder in which each MANO vertex samples local image features at its projected location. A hand-reconstruction backbone, jointly trained for reconstruction and contact, predicts these locations at inference without an auxiliary reconstructor. Training uses noise-perturbed ground-truth projections and end-to-end feature adaptation to improve robustness and contact-sensitive features. Abstract: Industrial design requires creative visual exploration while satisfying constraints that are often product-specific and implicit. Existing text-to-image (T2I) approaches can generate creative designs through concept blending or multi-agent self-enhancement, but they provide limited mechanisms for ensuring that generated designs remain consistent with such constraints. Given a product name, the framework constructs a brand image survey report that summarizes product and market information, derives a creative direction from the report, and integrates this direction into a self-enhancement loop in which generated images are critiqued and prompts are revised. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17767v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Flow-based generative models are trained on a hand-chosen prediction target, such as the velocity, the noise, or the clean data. This choice strongly affects training and sample quality. We introduce Anisotropic Flow Models (AnisoFlow), which replaces a fixed prediction target with a fully learnable one. AnisoFlow learns to scale the noise component of the target anisotropically, assigning a separate nonnegative weight to each direction in a jointly learned basis. A closed-form map recovers the velocity from the network's prediction, leaving the architecture, flow-matching loss, and sampler unchanged. Since recovery is exact, training optimizes the target purely to make it easier for the network to predict. We theoretically analyze the resulting prediction error and predict that the preferred noise weight in each direction scales near-linearly with data variance, in agreement with the weights learned empirically in pixel space. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17821v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Moving a scene generator to a new game engine requires more than exporting its final output: planning, construction tools, and stored experience may also depend on the original backend. We present SceneAgent, a multi-agent framework for reusing the construction process and its experience across backends. Abstract: Frozen vision foundation models can be adapted by learning a few prompt tokens shared across all images. When prompts are updated as data shift or tasks change, the distribution of image features moves from one endpoint to another. Prior theory asks which endpoints prompts can reach; we ask whether they can travel between them along the shortest path. Because shared prompts compete with each image's own content for attention, they often cannot. We quantify this restriction as the extra transport cost that shared attention imposes over the shortest path. In an exactly solvable attention model, the reachable features form a cone; unrolling it into a plane gives the exact minimum action for every pair of endpoints and explicit optimal prompts on short arcs. articles.content:

Abstract: Improving a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model requires demonstrations that address its weaknesses and provide effective supervision for learning. Coding agents can autonomously generate demonstrations through environment interaction, yet successful execution alone does not ensure effective supervision for VLA learning. We introduce Agentic-Teacher, an autonomous data engine for failure-driven VLA post-training. Given a VLA checkpoint, a task specification, and configured environment tools, the engine analyzes failed rollouts, selects intervention states, and iteratively develops closed-loop code policies through execution feedback. Validated policies become reusable demonstration generators that collect successful continuations from states where the VLA struggles. articles.content:

Abstract: A rescue robot entering a building with thirty seconds on the clock should sprint toward the single most promising room; given ten minutes, it should instead explore a broader tour. Yet vision-language-navigation (VLN) models are typically evaluated under a fixed episode limit that the policy never observes, even though time-critical missions require behavior to adapt to the available budget. We study budget-conditioned object search: given a target category and an explicit action budget, an agent must find as many distinct target instances as possible before the budget expires. We investigate how to supervise VLNs for this task by comparing a privileged TSP expert, which plans near-optimal routes using the full map and true target locations, with a room-level Bellman expert that maximizes expected return under partial observability using high-level cross-scene semantic priors. arXiv:2611.17529v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Image-goal planning with a frozen visual world model depends on how predicted observations are scored against the goal. Mean-squared error (MSE) between embeddings from a pretrained visual encoder can provide a useful signal near a goal, yet favor states across an obstacle that are visually similar to the goal and difficult to reach. We fit a small residual adapter on top of frozen I-JEPA embeddings to improve this latent goal cost. Starting near each goal, a planner collects trajectories from progressively wider regions of initial states. articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17566v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Safety in robotics does not solely depend on geometric constraints, but also on semantics: the given task, environment properties, and interactions between objects in the scene. We present a framework based on vision-language models (VLMs) to infer task- and scene-dependent safety constraints for robot manipulation. We provide the VLM a structured safety tool based on an RGB-D observation and a natural-language task instruction that first decides whether the task should be rejected since its execution may result in a non-recoverable hazardous outcome. Otherwise, it identifies preventable object-pair hazards and specifies the spatial relations that must be avoided. Open-vocabulary segmentation and depth information are then used to ground the detected objects in 3D and construct continuous risk fields that represent the corresponding hazardous regions. articles.title: Natural Swing-Up of an Underpowered Double Pendulum
articles.content:
arXiv:2611.17575v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Robots with weak motors must ride their natural dynamics rather than fight them. We swing up a direct-drive planar two-link robot, whose motors deliver only about 6\,\% of its shoulder gravity torque, along its nonlinear normal modes, two-dimensional invariant manifolds consisting of periodic orbits. On a non-strict mode, injecting energy necessarily moves the state off the manifold, so pumping and stabilization compete for the same bounded torque. We split the input torque into a power-neutral steering component and a scalar pumping input, the only component that changes the energy. The allocation then becomes a linear program in two variables: maximize pumping subject to the torque limits and one control-Lyapunov constraint. The constraint uses the model-based rate of the error, so no stabilizing feedback gain is needed. Abstract: Long-horizon navigation from indoors to outdoors remains an open problem for humanoid robots: one instruction covers rooms, doors and roads, and the camera moves with the gait. Worken, AGIBOT's measure of productive robot work, depends on robots that reach their workplaces autonomously. X-Nav covers a pipeline from data to deployment. Its data engine collects navigation data in open-source scenes, in digital twins of deployment sites and on real robots. Its navigation model, MELIOR, takes only RGB images from the robot's built-in camera and comes in two versions: MELIOR-A predicts actions, and MELIOR-N predicts a navigation goal. Abstract: Human demonstrations are becoming the main source of data for dexterous manipulation, and real-to-sim-to-real pipelines multiply each demonstration in simulation. These pipelines rebuild the interaction from vision, which recovers how the hand moves. Which fingers touch, when, and how hard remain unobserved, because a hand pose shows where each finger stops on the surface rather than how far it is driven to close. This gap is a force gap: on held-out recordings, a hand policy that imitates the observed pose grips with 0.31x the recorded force, and a policy trained on physics replays of vision-tracked poses grips with 1.55x. TouchTwin closes the gap with measured human touch. Each selected TouchScale recording, captured with head and wrist RGB-D cameras and an 880-taxel glove, is rebuilt in MuJoCo. Abstract: Visuomotor imitation learning has become a predominant paradigm for real-world robotic manipulation, yet it remains data-inefficient and brittle to task-irrelevant visual shifts. Pre-trained visual representations promise to ease this burden by distilling priors from internet-scale data, but the ``right'' representation for robotics remains unresolved: existing studies span broad but sparse task distributions and reach conclusions that vary and even conflict, pointing to strong task and setting dependence. We examine this question by bringing a magnifying glass to a common contact-rich manipulation task: insertion. Abstract: Imitation policies for robot manipulation are often trained on noisy object positions, and they learn to discount the noisy reading. We show how much they discount it, and why. Because demonstrators steer toward the object, the robot's own state carries information about where the object is. Abstract: Depth and 3D foundation models can predict geometry from RGB images, allowing zero-shot object navigation without a depth sensor. However, when predicted depth is mapped as if it came from a sensor, view-dependent errors accumulate in the map, remove exploration goals, and end the search before the agent can observe and correct them. We propose ERA, a training-free object navigation system that replaces the depth sensor with depth predicted from RGB images and poses. ERA follows a paradigm we call Move with Error: movement provides new views that correct map errors, and the corrected map enables further movement. It realizes this paradigm with revisable occupancy and with exploration from reachable viewpoints, which continues the search when no frontier remains, and verifies the target across views before stopping. articles.title: AI公司转型最难的一步：如何构建AI Native的产品体系
articles.content: 企业把大模型接进产品之后，新的经营问题才刚刚展开。客户提出一项任务，系统能拿到哪些信息，由谁核准结果，出现例外时如何处理，都会影响AI能否持续投入使用。产品演示中的能力，需要经由完整的服务过程才能转化为客户价值。王强宇出任百望股份首席执行官（CEO），为观察这项变化提供了一个具体切口：王强宇如何将百望的财税场景积累转化为专业模型与智能体产品，并让研发、交付和组织能力共同支撑商业化。产品的交付单位开始发生变化在传统软件服务中，功能上线、接口联通与流程配置，是重要的交付内容。AI进一步参与工作后，客户会关心一次任务能否可靠完成，以及整个过程需要多少人工干预。以交易核对为例，系统可能要在授权范围内读取发票、合同和付款记录，找到差异，列出依据，再把需要确认的事项交给相关岗位。对客户而言，价值取决于问题是否被准确识别、后续处理是否顺畅，以及投入的时间是否减少。这改变了产品设计的起点。团队需要明确服务哪类任务、满足什么条件可以执行、哪些情况应当停止或转交人工。模型、数据、工具和复核机制，需要围绕同一项任务组合。百望已推出AI财税专家团，在开票、记账和申报等服务中引入自然语言交互、标准化任务执行，并保留规则校验与人工确认。 沿着这一方向向更复杂的财税业务深入，可靠完成任务的能力将变得更加重要。这也是王强宇出任CEO值得关注的原因。产品服务范围扩大之后，研发投入、客户承诺和交付保障之间的取舍，往往需要公司经营层面统筹。让数据和专业判断进入同一条任务链百望的转型基础来自长期财税与交易服务，但这些积累要经过专业加工，才能成为AI可以使用的依据。同一笔业务，不同系统可能使用不同的客户名称、合同编号和记录口径。数据需要核对关联，规则需要注明适用条件，权限需要随任务执行。否则，即使模型能够解释财税概念，也可能无法判断眼前材料是否足够。专业领域垂直模型在这里承担专业理解与推理任务，知识系统提供持续更新的资料，智能体连接工具与工作流程。对于税额计算、规则校验等要求确定性的环节，还需要相应的程序和专业机制支撑。各层如何配合，应由任务要求和评测结果决定。Salesforce与英伟达推出的CRM推理模型Koa，提供了一个企业软件公司的参照：在开放模型基础上进行后训练，将企业工作流知识用于专业任务。按其公告，Koa训练使用合成场景，并未使用客户数据。专业能力可以通过多种方式形成，关键在于是否理解业务、是否能够接受验证。对于百望，模型建设与数据治理需要同步推进。经授权的业务信息、经过确认的专业知识，以及任务中的质量记录，应当分别管理、按需调用。业务反馈进入模型或产品改进之前，也需要专业审核与用途确认。客户现场能否改善下一次交付企业AI进入实际环境，经常需要重新理解客户的业务语言与流程。同样是合同核对，不同企业的管理制度、字段定义和系统接口，都会改变实施方式。王强宇此前谈及的FDE，即前沿部署工程师，正是连接模型能力与客户现场的一种组织方式。工程人员与行业专家共同厘清问题，确定所需数据、规则和工具，让方案在真实环境中接受检验。这项工作的经营价值，还取决于现场经验能否被复用。例如，团队在一个项目中完善了发票与合同的匹配方法，或识别出一类需要人工复核的例外，就需要判断它能否形成通用组件、规则模板或评测用例。后续客户因此减少重复开发与试错，才意味着公司的产品能力随项目增长而积累。相应地，交付周期、标准组件复用情况和单项目服务投入，都可以成为观察这种积累的依据。在部署方面，私有化或算力一体机可以回应部分客户对数据控制、系统接入与运行环境的需求。具体方案仍要结合任务量、硬件和运维投入评估。对百望来说，部署选择也应与交付和成本管理放在一起考虑。组织围绕任务协作才有共同的评价尺度当AI产品同时涉及专业判断和系统执行，单个部门很难独立保证结果。研发关注模型能力，产品需要界定服务范围，销售需要理解交付条件，实施团队又掌握客户现场的差异。这些团队需要对同一项任务形成共同定义。什么叫完成，什么叫失败，材料不足应怎样反馈，专业复核由谁负责，都应在项目推进过程中说清楚。否则，各部门即使完成了各自的工作，客户仍可能得不到完整服务。评价方式也要随之调整。技术评测之外，还需要观察任务成功率、人工复核与返工情况，以及客户的持续使用。产品是否扩大投入，可以结合这些结果与服务成本共同判断。CEO层面的统筹，有助于为跨部门取舍提供一致的依据：优先投入哪些场景，哪些需求可以标准化，哪些项目需要控制承诺，哪些经验应回到研发。王强宇从AI业务负责人走向CEO，其潜在作用正在于推动这些经营决策与技术路线衔接。这些是百望推进转型需要面对的组织任务，具体成效仍要由后续公开进展与客户结果验证。用经营结果解释科技公司的价值10月16日召开的国务院常务会议强调以落地应用牵引技术创新。对企业软件公司而言，回应这一方向，需要让A
